rails.source: Gemfile.lock (gem 'rails', '~> 8.1.0'); Phase 16 (branch upgrade/phase-16-rails-8-1, stacked on Phase 15 #238, which is stacked on Phase 13 #235; main is at 7.2.4)
rails.end_of_life: 2027-10-10 (end of security fixes for 8.1; bug fixes ended 2026-10-10)
rails.load_defaults: 8.0 (config/application.rb); config/initializers/new_framework_defaults_8_1.rb present with every key commented out (escape_json_responses, escape_js_separators_in_json, raise_on_missing_required_finder_order_columns, action_on_path_relative_redirect :raise, render_tracker :ruby, remove_hidden_field_autocomplete)
rails.notes: 8.1.4 is the newest 8.1 release (gem_lines.py, 2026-10-25) and the latest line; 8.2 is still on main. Requires Ruby >= 3.2 (Ruby 3.4.12 since Phase 13). load_defaults 8.0 in railties 8.1.4 is strict_freshness = true and Regexp.timeout ||= 1 on top of the 7.2 block — it no longer sets to_time_preserves_timezone, because 8.1 removed the old `to_time` behaviour and deprecated the setting itself (the four boot warnings Phase 15 recorded are gone without any config; setting :zone explicitly would now warn). The 8.1 order-dependent-finder deprecation fires only on models with no primary_key/implicit_order_column/query_constraints; every model here has an id, and the two `automation_scenarios.first` call sites got an explicit order(:created_at) as a clarification. db/schema.rb header is [8.1]; 8.1.4 dumps columns in migration order (the 8.1.0 alphabetical sort was reverted). Transitives: action_text-trix 2.1.19 new (actiontext 8.1), benchmark gem no longer a dependency. YJIT stays on in every environment (load_defaults 8.1 will turn it off for development/test in Phase 20). Phase 15's 8.0 (security support ends 2026-11-07) and this 8.1 should be promoted close together.
